title: EBI-Metagenomics/mag-polishing-pipeline pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be at least 7 characters and cannot contain spaces. miassembler substrings it to 7 characters to build its publish paths, so anything shorter aborts the run.

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. This pipeline is paired-end only.

genome.errorMessage: The eukaryotic reference genome for this sample must be provided and must have extension '.fa', '.fna' or '.fasta', optionally gzipped.
